wiki.title: Andy Vargas
wiki.extract: Andres X. "Andy" Vargas is an American politician serving as a member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives from the 3rd Essex district. A member of the Democratic Party, his district covers part of the city of Haverhill. Vargas serves as Chairperson of the Joint Committee on Community Development and Small Businesses. He is chair of the Massachusetts Black and Latino Legislative Caucus and a member of Phi Iota Alpha fraternity.
